papers.title: Influence of Selected Heat Treatment on Alloy Properties of Ti-6Al-4V Alloy
papers.abstract: Titanium is the polymorphic metal whose recrystallization temperature significantly affects its final properties. The area between 850 C and 995 C is a very important area from the point of view of heat treatment of titanium alloys. It is a transition area just below the β transition limit. This article deals with the analysis of the influence of thermal loading on the change in tensile strength and fracture behavior of titanium alloys in comparison with thermally unloaded samples. Monitoring of fracture surfaces and description of the internal structure of the material.

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文研究了热处理对Ti-6Al-4V合金拉伸性能和断裂行为的影响，属于后处理控制方向，但未涉及疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not include fatigue testing or detailed analysis of post-processing effects on fatigue life.

summary_zh.motivation: 分析热处理对Ti-6Al-4V合金性能的影响，特别是β转变区附近的热处理。
summary_zh.method: 对比热加载样品与未热加载样品的拉伸强度和断裂面观察。
summary_zh.result: 热处理显著改变了合金的拉伸强度和断裂行为。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试和断口形貌分析验证。

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates the effect of heat treatment on the tensile strength and fracture behavior of Ti-6Al-4V alloy, focusing on the beta transition region.
summary_en.method: Tensile tests and fracture surface analysis were conducted on thermally loaded and unloaded samples.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment significantly altered the tensile properties and fracture mechanisms of the alloy.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through mechanical testing and microstructural observation.
